UPSC Geo-Scientist Online Form 2027 - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for the post of Combined Geo Scientist Pre Examination 2027. This recruitment has been issued for 127 posts. The online application process for UPSC Geo-Scientist Recruitment 2027 has started on 02 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 22 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSC Geo-Scientist Recruitment 2027, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 10 January 2027
  • Pre Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Mains Exam Date : 19-20 June 2027

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
